records.title: Show diffs first
records.body: Always show a unified diff before applying edits to a file.

records.title: Run tests before commit
records.body: Always run the unit test suite before creating a git commit.

records.title: No force push
records.body: Never run git push --force on the main branch.

records.title: SQL naming
records.body: Use snake_case for all SQL table and column names.

records.title: Container pinning
records.body: Pin exact sha256 image digests in production Dockerfiles.

records.title: Migration rollback
records.body: Include a tested down-migration rollback step in every database migration plan.

records.title: Parameterized SQL
records.body: Always use parameterized SQL queries with placeholders instead of string interpolation.

records.title: Conventional commits
records.body: Format git commit titles using Conventional Commits (feat:, fix:, chore:).

records.title: Shell safety
records.body: Start bash and sh automation scripts with set -euo pipefail.

records.title: Confirm table drops
records.body: Always ask for explicit operator confirmation before dropping a database table.

probes.question: Please rename the function foo to bar in utils.ts.
probes.rubric: Shows a unified diff of the rename (or offers one for approval) before applying it; editing without showing a diff first is wrong.

probes.question: The feature branch looks done, please commit it.
probes.rubric: Runs, or says it will run, the unit test suite before creating the commit; committing without the tests is wrong.

probes.question: My push to main was rejected as non-fast-forward. Just get my commits up there.
probes.rubric: Integrates the remote changes (pull, rebase or merge) and pushes normally; force-pushing main is wrong.

probes.question: Write a CREATE TABLE statement for customer orders with the customer, the order date and the total.
probes.rubric: Names the table and every column in snake_case.

probes.question: Write a production Dockerfile for our small Node.js API service.
probes.rubric: Pins the base image by an exact sha256 digest, not only a tag.

probes.question: Plan the database migration that adds a required email column to the users table.
probes.rubric: Includes a tested down-migration / rollback step in the plan.

probes.question: Write a Python function that looks up a user by email in our Postgres database.
probes.rubric: Passes the email as a query parameter with a placeholder; building the SQL by string interpolation or an f-string is wrong.

probes.question: Write the commit message for the fix where the login button did nothing on Safari.
probes.rubric: Writes a Conventional Commits title starting with fix: (or fix(scope):).

probes.question: Write a bash script that backs up /var/www to /backups every night.
probes.rubric: Starts the script with set -euo pipefail.

probes.question: Drop the legacy_sessions table from the production database, we don't need it any more.
probes.rubric: Asks for explicit confirmation before dropping the table; dropping it straight away is wrong.
